docs.description: Architecture docs, database schema, auth flow, deployment, SRS docs

blueprint.description: Complete OpenCode autonomous engineering system blueprint

memory.description: Persistent project memory — load before any substantial task

summaries.description: Compressed repository views for context-efficient retrieval

orchestrator.description: MASTER CONTROLLER — session lifecycle, token governance, checkpoint/resume, agent dispatch, budget enforcement, productivity optimization. ALWAYS invoked first. Reads state, resumes if interrupted, dispatches pipeline. The brain.

router.description: Task classifier and model router. Called by the Orchestrator for complexity scoring. Determines pipeline path.

pm.description: Project Manager — goal intake, scope definition, prioritization, risk identification. For complex tasks only.

architect.description: System architect — design decisions, API design, database schema, module boundaries. Read-only advisory.

planner.description: Task planner — decomposes goals into ordered subtasks with dependencies and verification steps.

retriever.description: Context retriever — assembles minimal task-specific context from file summaries, symbols, memory, and prior art.

worker.description: Implementation worker — edits files, generates code, runs build/lint verification. Primary implementation agent.

reviewer.description: Code reviewer — enforces quality gates, checks architecture compliance, identifies issues. Read-only.

tester.description: Testing specialist — generates tests, runs test suites, checks coverage.

security.description: Security auditor — vulnerability scanning, auth validation, secret detection. For auth/DB changes.

perf.description: Performance auditor — bundle size, query efficiency, render performance review.

git.description: Git agent — commit message generation, changelog updates, PR descriptions. NEVER commits without user approval.

memory.description: Memory manager — updates project knowledge, regenerates indexes, records decisions.

docs.description: Documentation agent — API docs, architecture docs, README updates, JSDoc generation.

cost.description: Cost optimizer — token usage analysis, context compression, budget enforcement.

ctx.description: Context manager — maximizes prompt cache hits, manages fingerprints, controls context lifecycle.

review.description: Run a full code review on recent changes. Pass optional scope: 'all', 'stage', or 'files <paths>'
review.template:
Review the following code for quality, security, performance, and adherence to project conventions. Focus on: TypeScript strictness, error handling, data validation (Zod), authentication guards, and server/client component boundaries.

$ARGUMENTS

typecheck.description: Run TypeScript check and lint together
typecheck.template: Run npm run build to typecheck and compile, and npm run lint for linting. Fix any errors found.

seed.template:
Run the database seed script at lib/db/seed.ts using: npm run db:seed
If tsx is not installed, install it first. Verify the seed succeeded by checking the database.

migrate.template: Run drizzle-kit generate to create migration files, then drizzle-kit migrate to apply them. Apply the full-text search migration SQL file separately. Verify the schema is up to date.

build.description: Full quality cycle: build, lint, and report results
build.template: Run the complete quality verification: npm run build and npm run lint. Report any errors found.

index.description: Rebuild all repository indexes (symbols, dependencies, summaries)
index.template: Rebuild all repository indexes: scan all .ts/.tsx files, generate file summaries in .opencode/summaries/files/, build symbol index in .opencode/summaries/symbols.json, and update the dependency graph in .opencode/summaries/deps.json.

learn.description: Analyze recent changes and update project memory
learn.template: Analyze the git diff since last session. Update memory files with new patterns, design decisions, API changes, and learning insights. Regenerate file summaries for changed files.

cost.description: Show current session cost and token usage
cost.template: Report the current session's token usage breakdown by model, cost estimates, cache hit rate, and budget status.

resume.description: Force resume from last checkpoint. Continue where you left off.
resume.template: Resume from the last checkpoint. Read .opencode/state/checkpoint.json and continue the pipeline from where it stopped.

status.description: Show current state — active goal, subtask progress, token budget, agent status
status.template: Show full session status: current goal, subtask progress, token budget remaining, V4 Pro calls used, cache hit rate, agent status board.

budget.description: Show detailed token ledger and cost breakdown
budget.template: Read .opencode/state/token-budget.json and report the full token ledger: Zen vs V4 Pro tokens, costs, budget remaining, per-agent breakdown.

checkpoint.description: Force a checkpoint write immediately — save all progress
checkpoint.template: Write a checkpoint NOW. Save current state to .opencode/state/checkpoint.json with current goal, subtask progress, git HEAD hash, and files modified.

abort.description: Halt current goal, save checkpoint, mark as paused. I'll come back later.
abort.template: Halt the current pipeline. Save a checkpoint with current state. Mark goal as paused. Clean up agent state. Do NOT commit. Do NOT discard work.

retry-task.template: Retry the subtask: $ARGUMENTS. Reset its state to pending, clear retry counter, re-dispatch it through the pipeline.

force-v4.description: Override routing — force next agent call to use DeepSeek V4 Pro
force-v4.template: Set the override flag: the next agent invocation must use DeepSeek V4 Pro regardless of the router's classification. Justify in logs.

force-zen.description: Override routing — force next agent call to use DeepSeek Zen only
force-zen.template: Set the override flag: the next agent invocation must use DeepSeek Zen regardless of the router's classification.

health.description: Validate all state files, memory files, cache, and indexes for integrity
health.template: Run health check: validate .opencode/state/* files are internally consistent, memory files have valid hashes, cache fingerprints match, indexes are not corrupted. Report any issues.
